description: This Java source file defines an Android input method service (IME) called ImageKeyboard. Its main purpose is to provide a custom keyboard that allows users to insert images (GIF, PNG, WebP) into text input fields via the CommitContent API. It handles requesting necessary permissions, preparing image files from raw resources, and creating UI buttons to insert specific images.

classes.name: ImageKeyboard
classes.description: An Android IME service that allows users to insert images into text fields by utilizing the CommitContent API.

methods.name: isCommitContentSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current input editor supports committing content of a specific MIME type.

methods.name: doCommitContent
methods.description: Prepares and commits image content to the active input connection, handling URI permissions and validation.

methods.name: validatePackageName
methods.description: Verifies that the package name of the input editor is valid and matches the system's expectations for security.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the IME, loading image resources into files for later insertion.

methods.name: onCreateInputView
methods.description: Creates the input view UI, which includes buttons to insert different image types.

methods.name: onEvaluateFullscreenMode
methods.description: Overrides default behavior to avoid full-screen mode, ensuring inserted content remains visible.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Enables or disables content insertion buttons based on input target support.

methods.name: getFileForResource
methods.description: Helper method to extract raw resource data into temporary files for content insertion.
